sections.summary: Senior Product Manager with a track record of owning complex, data-intensive platform portfolios—including ~52 enterprise APIs across multiple engineering teams—and driving large-scale modernization initiatives such as SOAP-to-REST migrations, cloud datacenter transitions, and a $7M multi-year enterprise transformation. Experienced delivering end-to-end roadmaps for platforms serving 1.5M+ users, orchestrating release readiness for 300+ enterprise systems, and translating ambiguous technical requirements into structured backlogs with clear acceptance criteria and delivery priorities. Brings additional depth in AI-native product development, having architected a zero-to-one decision intelligence platform with governance-oriented workflows, explainability frameworks, and bounded AI augmentation—directly applicable to responsible data platform and ML product work. Adept at aligning cross-functional stakeholders, managing compliance and security constraints, and sustaining operational continuity across distributed, mission-critical environments.

bullets.text: Owned product responsibilities across a portfolio of ~52 enterprise APIs and 2+ engineering teams, maintaining a four-sprint backlog spanning ~10 product features and 3 migration initiatives while balancing feature delivery, compliance, vulnerability remediation, and technical debt.

Led modernization of legacy SOAP services to REST architectures and coordinated Java-to-Go migration—managing requirements, acceptance criteria, UAT, and production readiness—while executing a zero-downtime datacenter migration from ATL to DFW on AWS, covering the full ~52-API portfolio.

Translated business, security, and architecture needs into prioritized, execution-ready features and user stories, facilitating cross-team refinement sessions to surface dependencies, sequencing plans, and operational risks across multiple delivery teams.

Partnered across engineering, architecture, QA, security, release, and business stakeholders to coordinate dependencies, escalate blockers, and ensure production readiness—leading UAT validation and release coordination in a highly regulated financial services environment.

Owned and prioritized a complex Agile backlog supporting 400+ personalization experiences, 1,400+ insights, and 35 integrated systems across member-facing banking and insurance platforms, directing delivery coordination across engineering, analytics, architecture, QA, and operations teams.

Owned end-to-end product roadmap and backlog for enterprise digital platforms serving 1.5M+ residential and commercial users, establishing vision, success criteria, and delivery priorities across customer-facing utility systems.
Authored PRD that initiated a $7M multi-year enterprise transformation initiative, securing executive sponsorship and modernization alignment across 130+ integrated systems.

Leveraged analytics and platform insights to identify optimization opportunities, dependency risks, and customer experience improvements, translating customer, business, technical, and accessibility requirements into executable Agile delivery plans.
Coordinated research, design, engineering, vendors, and cross-functional stakeholders within a regulated public utility to drive data-informed digital capabilities on a predictable Agile cadence.
Maintained enterprise governance and accessibility standards throughout delivery while partnering across business and technology functions to improve customer-facing digital experiences.

Evaluated 200+ AI, automation, and defense technology concepts within a DoD innovation incubator, applying structured feasibility assessment and product thinking to support leadership prioritization and early-stage investment decisions.

Guided cross-functional teams through the full product lifecycle—discovery, MVP definition, workflow design, and operational planning—for mission-oriented technology initiatives in a U.S. Air Force ecosystem.

Translated complex emerging technology concepts into actionable product roadmaps by applying structured problem framing and communicating technical solutions for operational stakeholders in complex deployment environments.

Assessed 3,078+ enterprise web pages within the AFPIMS ecosystem (supporting 1,600+ DoD sites) and delivered architecture, workflow, and governance artifacts that reduced digital footprint by 40% while raising task-completion and usability success rates to 80%.

Translated complex DoD modernization requirements into structured delivery work—spanning information architecture, governance documentation, and future-state planning—coordinating across federal stakeholders, technical teams, and partner organizations supporting Defense Logistics Agency enterprise website modernization.

Orchestrated end-to-end migration planning, QA coordination, and release readiness for 300+ enterprise websites, managing deployment sequencing and stakeholder coordination to support 800+ enterprise users across distributed systems environments.
Standardized delivery and release workflows to improve deployment consistency, operational predictability, and system stability across enterprise environments.

Served as liaison to the Information Protection enterprise, coordinating clearance status and program documentation for ~85 personnel across organizational boundaries within a regulated security environment.
Drove cross-functional alignment during transition to a new clearance evaluation system, navigating disciplined documentation requirements and access governance protocols to ensure continuity.

Managed IT and cyber-support capabilities for ~120 personnel across NIPR/SIPR environments, overseeing compliance, funding and resource planning, and operational readiness to sustain mission-critical infrastructure.

Coordinated a ~60-workstation technical refresh and led infrastructure lifecycle modernization, identifying dependencies and mitigating risks to maintain operational continuity with minimal escalation.
Led vulnerability-assessment planning across military environments, applying structured risk awareness and rapid domain acquisition to proactively surface and address security exposures.

Drove cross-functional alignment across technology, program, and operational workstreams in complex military environments, leveraging interpersonal and coordination skills to execute structured programs under competing priorities.

Architected and built a zero-to-one AI-native decision intelligence product end-to-end—spanning React/Tailwind frontend, FastAPI/Python backend, and MongoDB—with an ontology-driven scoring framework using weighted deterministic logic, confidence calibration, and LLM-generated narrative to deliver explainable readiness assessments across organizational domains.

Designed a governance-oriented product model encompassing structured evidence collection, blocker tracking, remediation workflows, reassessment cycles, and immutable versioned Decision Records, ensuring human authority, auditability, and bounded AI augmentation throughout the decision lifecycle.
Developing and validating a repeatable AI-augmented product execution model
Model covers translating product decisions into specifications, implementation, validation, recovery, and captured learning
